noun_definition: mweb refers to the mobile web version of the application where users can create and manage group chats.
Chat refers to a group messaging feature that allows multiple users to communicate together, where a welcome group message is displayed to introduce the participants.

The welcome group message refers to the initial notification or text displayed in a group chat that indicates the members of the group, which should not include any users who have been removed from the group.
User refers to an individual participant in a group chat who can be added or removed from the chat members.
